questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.**

_______ he plays well he has not been selected in the team.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

__
 
• **Though **is a conjunction of concession.__ It shows a contrast with the main idea.
 
• **Unless **is a conjunction of __condition__
 
• **Since **and** Because **are conjunctions of __cause or reason__

**Though** makes the sentence grammatically correct.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Thank you for your ______ to speak at the conference in March.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **invitation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Conclusion **means an opinion that you reach after thinking about something carefully.
 
• **Inclusion **means the act of including someone or something as part of a group, list, etc.
 
• **Invitation **means a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.
 
• **Introduction **means the act of telling two or more people each other’s names for the first time.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words '**invitation**' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **I appreciate the opportunity to speak at the conference in March.**

​Therefore, The correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *Thank you for your invitation __to speak at the conference in March.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Please sign these documents ______ ink so that they can be preserved.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 4) i.e. 'in'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• We always use the preposition 'in'__ when we describe some characteristic intrinsic to the writing itself.
 
• IN: To write in something (where 'in' denotes a method or style, not location or position) is to describe some characteristic intrinsic to the writing itself:
 __
 
• in cursive
 
• in Russian
 
• in Ink
 
 
 
• **The correct sentence:** "*Please sign these documents** in** ink so that they can be preserved.*"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• You might get confused with in and with. But, there is a difference:
 
• WITH: To write with something (where 'with' indicates agency and not accompaniment) usually relates something about the writer, the writer's tools, or the writing process; I can write
 
 
• with a feather quill
 
• with a flourish
 
• with the memory still fresh in my mind
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Prepositions show the relationship between 2 words :

 
• **With-**- is used for instruments: "*She hit him with a stick.*"
 
• **By**-- is used for agents: "*It was written by a great poet."*
 
• **From**-- is used to show the starting point: "*The concert is from 6 p.m. onwards.*"

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to ﬁll in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.

Robert and Rooney aren’t very good friends although they ________ each other for a long time.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer of this question is **option 2) ' have known'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Using ' have known' in the place of blank space to make the sentence correct.
 
• We should use present perfect tense here . We cannot use past tense '**knew' **as past tense use is not right here . 
 
• We also can not use '**has known'** as it is incorrect because here we are talking about two friends so singular form "has" should not come here.​

**​The Correct sentence is : *** Robert and Rooney aren't very good friends although they*** have known ***each other for a long time.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom ( in the context) to fill in the sentence.

In my parents’ time, we mostly ate at home and family outings happened ______
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 4.**

**In fine feather** means in excellent form, health, or humour

**Shoulder to shoulder** means work together.

**Behind the back** means done without someone knowing about it.

**Once in a blue moon** means to do very rarely.

The speaker wants to convey that **family outings occurred rarely**. So, option 4 is correct.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scientists have discovered evidence of abundant water-bearing minerals on the ______ of an asteroid Bennu.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**surface**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Meaning of the words given in the options are:**

 
 
• **Ground** means** an area of land or sea used for a specified purpose.**
 
• **Earth** means **the planet on which we live; the world.**
 
• **Soil** means **the upper layer of earth in which plants grow, a black or dark brown material typically consisting of a mixture of organic remains, clay, and rock particles.**
 
• Surface means the outside part or uppermost layer of something.
 
 
• *For eg; The earth's surface is fit for plant growth.*
 
 
 
 
 
• It is clear that the surface is the most appropriate word as the sentence mentions a discovery on the uppermost layer of an asteroid.
 
• So, options **1,3, and 4** are **incorrect.**

**Thus, the complete sentence is: ***Scientists have discovered evidence of abundant water-bearing minerals on the surface of an asteroid Bennu.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.

People tend to turn a blind eye _____ crime against women.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

Prepositions 'in', 'on', 'at' are usually used to refer time, date, days (period).

To is the correct usage and makes the sentence grammatically correct.

The correct sentence will be: *People tend to turn a blind eye __to__ crime against women.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I was _________ by the sound of the doorbell.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **awakened.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Awaken:** to make somebody/something wake up.

 
 
• Ruby was **awakened** by a knock at her door. 
 
 
 
• Also, **'awakened'** is followed by the preposition **'by'.**
 
• The given sentence conveys that the person was made to wake up by the sound of the bell.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is** 'awakened'.**

**Correct Sentence: ***I was **awakened**__ by the sound of the doorbell.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Enhance: **to improve something or to make something look better.
 
• **Enable: **to make it possible for somebody/something to do something.
 
• **Activate: **to make something start working.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Many items made of ivory were ______ from a dealer in antiques by the custom authorities at the Delhi airport.
questions.solution:
The correct word to be used in the blank is “confiscated”. It means “took or seized (someone's property) with authority.

Eg: The guards confiscated his camera.

The meanings of the rest of the words are:

Appropriated: took(something) for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission

Annexed: add (territory) to one's own territory by appropriation

Hijacked: unlawfully seize (an aircraft, ship, or vehicle) in transit and force it to go to a different destination or use it for one's own purposes

Hence, these options are incorrect.

Hence the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

During her vacation, Shanta ______ her mother when she went to work in the mall
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Accompanied'**.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **past tense** that can be identified by the usage of the second form **'went'**.
 
• During the vacation, normally children wish to spend time with their parents. The same situation has been stated in the sentence.
 
• **Accompany (verb) **means **'to go somewhere with someone as a companion'**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
• Associate (verb) - **to connect someone or something in your mind with someone or something else** - *He is glad to be **associated **with this project.*
 
• Abandon (verb) - **to leave something or someone usually forever** - * The king **abandoned **his kingdom and spent the rest of his life as a saint.*
 
• Isolate (Verb) - **to separate something from other things with which it is connected **- He isolated himself from the company of narrow-minded people.*
